deeper_caverns (Zone) }} The '''Dwarven Mines''' is a location that is focused on {{Skill|Mining}}. It has several unique [[Dwarven Metals]], including {{Item|Mithril}} and {{Item|Titanium}}: the [[Heart of the Mountain]] is also unlocked here. {{Skill|Mining 12}} and completion of {{NPCSprite|Rhys}}' quest is required to access the '''Dwarven Mines'''. == Overview == The primary focuses of the '''Dwarven Mines''' are to complete [[Commissions]], which are tasks given by the {{NPCSprite|King}}, to level up your [[Heart of the Mountain]], collect better tools via {{Zone|The Forge}}, and collect different varieties of [[Powder (disambiguation)|Powder]]: those being {{Mithril Powder}}, {{Gemstone Powder}}, and {{Glacite Powder}}. {{ZoneText|&7Mine rare ores.}} == Layout == {{Main|Station Master}} Players will arrive in the {{Zone|Dwarven Village}}, where {{NPCSprite|Rhys}} can be found, as well as several commodities: {{NPCSprite|Bubu}} sells pickaxes with various stats, {{NPCSprite|Bulvar}} sells Tier 12 mining minions, {{NPCSprite|Banker Broadjaw}} allows players to access their Bank, {{NPCSprite|Lumina}} sells various light sources, {{NPCSprite|Fragilis}} shows the Handy Block Guide, and {{NPCSprite|Geo}} allows players to add [[Gemstones]] to their items. The gate to the [[Crystal Hollows]] can be found at {{NPCSprite|Gwendolyn}}, who can be found at the outskirts of the Dwarven Village: after reaching {{Coll|Heart of the Mountain IV}}, the player can pay a {{c}} fee to enter the Crystal Hollows for {{Green|6}} hours. Exiting the Dwarven Village will reveal a crossroads: the left path leads to the {{Zone|Royal Palace}} via the {{Zone|Palace Bridge}}, which overlooks the {{Zone|Royal Mines}}; the right path leads to the rest of the Dwarven Mines via the {{Zone|Gates to the Mines}}, which overlooks {{Zone|The Forge}}. Beyond the {{Zone|Great Ice Wall}}, the {{Zone|Dwarven Base Camp}} can be found: it is inaccessible without {{Coll|Heart of the Mountain VII}} and completion of {{NPCSprite|Dulin}}'s quest, which also grants permanent free entry to the [[Crystal Hollows]]. The {{NPCSprite|Station Master}} can be found in the {{Zone|Dwarven Village}}, with several {{NPCSprite|Ticket Master}}s found around stations in the Dwarven Mines. After paying a small {{c}} fee, depending on your proximity to your desired location, players can enter a minecart and travel to other areas around the '''Dwarven Mines'''. == Events == {{hatnote|'''Mining Events''' redirects here, for the event introduced by [[Cole]], see [[Mining Fiesta]].}} '''Events''' will regularly happen around the Dwarven Mines every {{Green|20}} minutes: they are either '''Active''', '''Passive''', or '''Random'''. {| class="wikitable" ! Name !! Type !! Description |- ! [[2x Powder|{{TA|2x Powder}}]] | Passive | While is event is active, all {{Mithril Powder}}, {{Gemstone Powder}}, and {{Glacite Powder}} obtained will be {{Green|doubled}}. |- ! [[Better Together|{{TA|Better Together}}]] | Passive | While this event is active, players gain increased {{Stat|ms}} and {{Stat|mnf}} when they are in the same zone as another player, up to {{Green|5}} players. |- ! [[Mithril Gourmand|{{TA|Mithril Gourmand}}]] | Active | While this event is active, {{NPCSprite|Don Expresso}} appears in the {{Zone|Dwarven Tavern}}. Mining {{Item|Mithril}} in a specified area has a chance to drop {{Item|Tasty Mithril}}: {{Green|200}} of this must be given to Don to complete the event, and giving at least {{Green|10}} personally will grant extra rewards. |- ! [[Raffle|{{TA|Raffle}}]] | Active | While this event is active, a '''Raffle Box''' appears in a random location: {{Item|Raffle Ticket}}s will also spawn in the zone, and must be handed in to the Raffle Box before the event ends. The more tickets you deposit, the higher the chance of you winning the raffle and gaining increased rewards. |- ! [[Goblin Raid|{{TA|Goblin Raid}}]] | Active | While this event is active, several hordes of [[Goblins]] will appear in a specified location and must be defeated within {{Green|5}} minutes for participants to claim rewards. |- ! [[Fallen Star|{{TA|Fallen Star}}]] | Random | A [[Fallen Star]] will randomly fall in a random location: {{Item|Mithril}}, {{Item|Titanium}}, and {{Mithril Powder}} drops are increased, {{Item|Starfall}} has a chance to be obtained, and {{MobSprite|Star Sentry;Star Sentries}} will spawn. |- ! [[Powder Ghast|{{TA|Powder Ghast}}]] | Random | A {{MobSprite|Powder Ghast}} will appear in a random location and must be shot several times in order to be killed. Each successful shot grants {{Mithril Powder}}. |} == Zones == {{:Locations/Dwarven Mines}} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == Trivia == *The map for the Dwarven Mines is internally called the '''Deeper Caverns'''. *The Dwarven Mines were possibly initially called the Dwarven Caves. Trying to use the {{Item|Royal Pigeon}} outside of the Dwarven Mines would previously display the message, "You may not use this Item outside the Dwarven Caves!". *There used to be a hole in the ceiling (located at 66, 222, -83) that would lead the player onto the roof of the mines, where there was text, written in blocks, that read: **"WHY ARE YOU UP HERE?"
"COS"
"THE NERVE!" *Before [[Changelog/2021/November 8|November 8, 2021]], players could use the command {{Code|/warpforge}} to travel to {{Zone|The Forge}}, without having to consume a [[Travel Scrolls|Travel Scroll]]. Since November 8, 2021, a Travel Scroll must be consumed in order for the command to function. Prior to the update, the command could also be used while combat tagged or as a spectator in Dungeons. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.11|Added '''Dwarven Mines'''.}} {{history|2021/April 22|link=https://hypixel.net/threads/april-30-farming-island-follow-up-patch.4150652/|Added background soundtrack.}} {{History|0.20.2|Special ores, such as {{item|Mithril}} and {{item|Gemstone}}s, now respawn even if the chunk they're in gets unloaded.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Dwarven Mines/Locations}} {{Nav/Locations}} [[Category:Mining]] [[Category:Locations]]
